summary.text: HOBBYDRIVHUS AS is a private limited company registered in Gjerstad, founded 2007-11-05. HOBBYDRIVHUS AS buys and sells greenhouses, and sells goods by mail order and online. Its main industry code is 46.830: wholesale of wood, construction materials and sanitary equipment. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 5 788 103 NOK and the annual result was 235 361 NOK; operating income was down from 6 467 758 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -456 645 NOK in 2024 to 235 361 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 1 823 097 NOK in 2024 to 2 058 458 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Terje Rødland (daglig leder and styrets leder). Its verified website is hobbydrivhus.no, which links to its Facebook profile. The registered employee count went from 5 on 2026-06-13 to 7 on 2026-08-13. The register's most recent update was on 2026-08-13 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
